broje.options.enabled.tooltip: Enable Broje effects. Press Apply to save settings and update rendering.
broje.options.fog.tooltip: Depth-aware height fog in air. Underwater absorption and scattering are controlled on the Water page.
broje.options.volumetric.tooltip: Integrate a heterogeneous 3D fog volume up to the visible surface. Fog banks stay in world space as you move. Off uses inexpensive smooth height fog.
broje.options.density.tooltip: How quickly visibility decreases with distance. Nearby objects remain clearer because light travels through less fog. Zero disables the pass.
broje.options.start.tooltip: Distance from the camera before fog starts accumulating. Set to zero for continuous scattering from the camera.
broje.options.height.tooltip: Absolute world Y above which the fog becomes progressively thinner. Low ground and valleys hold denser fog.
broje.options.falloff.tooltip: Vertical distance over which fog above the layer height thins to about 37% of its original density. Larger values produce a deeper layer.
broje.options.variation.tooltip: Strength of world-space density variation in 3D mode. Zero gives smooth height fog without patches.
broje.options.wind.tooltip: Slow movement of 3D fog banks. Zero freezes the volume. Drift follows world time, including pause.
broje.options.distance.tooltip: Maximum distance the rays travel through fog. Always limited by scene depth; it cannot reveal fog behind blocks.
broje.options.fog_resolution.tooltip: 50% saves GPU time (one quarter of the integration pixels), 75% balances quality, 100% uses full resolution. Depth-aware reconstruction preserves block edges. Smooth height fog always uses full resolution.
broje.options.quality.tooltip: Maximum ray-march samples per pixel: 16 / 32 / 48 / 64. Higher settings reduce sampling grain and increase GPU cost. Short rays use fewer samples.
broje.options.shadows.tooltip: Soft shadows from opaque terrain and foliage, including loaded casters behind the camera. Faces turned away from the sun are shaded like cast shadows. Requires Enable Broje. Disabled at night and outside the Overworld.
broje.options.shadow_resolution.tooltip: 1024 / 1536 / 2048 / 3072 / 4096, as in Beryl. Higher resolution improves thin details and contact. Default 2048. Applied with Apply.
broje.options.shadow_distance.tooltip: Shadow distance in chunks, 2 to 12. Shadows fade over the last 30% of the range. Smaller ranges give more detail per texel; use 3072 or 4096 for 8–12 chunks.
broje.options.shadow_strength.tooltip: Darkening of the sunlight contribution; ambient light remains visible.
broje.options.shadow_softness.tooltip: PCF radius in map texels. 100% is about one texel, as sharp as Beryl. Texels near the player are several times smaller than far away.
broje.options.shadow_quality.tooltip: 8 / 16 / 24 bilinear PCF taps, with receiver-plane correction at every depth comparison. Higher settings improve smooth edges.
broje.options.colored_shadows.tooltip: Glass, ice, slime and honey tint sunlight. Choose realistic or bright mixing and adjust overlapping colors independently.
broje.options.colored_contrast.tooltip: How strongly glass tints the sunlight. 0% gives no color, 100% is the natural tint, higher values make colored spots deeper and more saturated.
broje.options.colored_mixing.tooltip: Realistic/pigment: mean filter to fully combined layers. Colored light: neutral to fully mixed colored light.
broje.options.shadow_filter.tooltip: Sharp: blocky pixel edges of the shadow map. Crisp: thin clean edge. Soft: the previous filter. Smooth: an even gradient without bands. Contact: hard near the caster, softer the farther the shadow falls. Softness scales the last three.
broje.options.reset.tooltip: Immediately reset and save all Broje settings on every page. Discards pending edits. Keeps the master switch.
broje.options.foliage_shadows.tooltip: Grass, flowers, saplings and other crossed-quad plants cast shadows. On meadows this produces many small spots, so it is off by default. Leaves, fences and blocks always cast.
broje.options.lighting.tooltip: Beryl-style lighting: sky light and direct sunlight are separated. Shadows receive light bounced off sunlit surfaces, corners are occluded, shade takes the sky color and sunlight the sun color. Overworld only; bounce light needs sun shadows.
broje.options.bounce.tooltip: One bounce of sunlight within 4 blocks: walls and nooks next to sunlit ground get brighter. Reflectors come from the shadow map.
broje.options.light_color.tooltip: Sky light depends on the face direction: blue from above, warm ground bounce from below. Direct light warms at sunset, torch light turns more orange. 0 keeps neutral lighting.
broje.options.lighting_quality.tooltip: 8 / 16 / 24 samples for bounce light and up to 16 for ambient occlusion. More is smoother and heavier on the GPU.
broje.options.entity_shadows.tooltip: Mobs, players, items and block entities cast model-shaped shadows. Removes vanilla circular shadows where the solar map is active. Preserves vanilla fallback outside it, at night, or with sun shadows off.
broje.options.foliage_glow.tooltip: Leaves and grass glow when you look through them toward the sun (subsurface scattering). 0 disables it.
broje.options.light_shafts.tooltip: Volumetric light: 3D fog is lit by the sun only where it reaches, so trees and hills carve shadows and beams into the fog. Needs 3D fog and shadows.
broje.options.sun_path_tilt.tooltip: −60° to 60°. At 0° the noon sun is overhead and shadows fall directly below objects. 20° matches Beryl's tilt. The visible sun, lighting and fog share the same direction; shadow length also depends on time of day.
broje.options.colored_blend.tooltip: Realistic: overlapping filters absorb and darken light. Bright pigment: preserves the multiplied hue with restored brightness. Colored light: averages hues without cumulative darkening; red and blue make bright purple.
broje.options.colored_brightness.tooltip: Brightness through glass: 100% is normal, up to 200% makes brighter patches. Does not brighten opaque shadows.
broje.options.colored_saturation.tooltip: 0% is grey, 100% is the original color, up to 200% gives vivid hues. Independent of brightness.
broje.options.colored_overlap.tooltip: Only affects two or more overlapping panes. 100% preserves the chosen mixing mode; 150–200% lifts the mixed color.
broje.options.sun_bloom_strength.tooltip: Glow extracted from the visible bright solar disk. 0% disables bloom; 100% is standard, 200% gives strong glare. Occluded sunlight does not create glow.
broje.options.sun_bloom_radius.tooltip: Width of the soft halo. Does not resize the disk. Bloom uses reduced-resolution buffers.
broje.options.water.tooltip: Waves, clear water, reflections and underwater lighting. Requires the Broje master switch.
broje.options.water_ssr.tooltip: Reflects visible shores and objects. Sky fills missing screen-space information.
broje.options.water_waves.tooltip: Wave height and surface ripples. Zero gives calm water.
broje.options.water_refraction.tooltip: Distorts the bottom through the water, with depth checks along shores.
broje.options.water_absorption.tooltip: Higher values make deep water darker and more saturated.
broje.options.water_caustics.tooltip: Moving sunlight patterns on submerged surfaces. Fades in shadow and with depth.
broje.options.underwater_shafts.tooltip: Volumetric underwater light using the sun shadow map. Enable sun shadows.
broje.options.water_quality.tooltip: 16: economical; 32: balanced; 64: precise. Maximum reflection search steps. Block faces are refined in the cheap mode too. Underwater sunlight quality is independent.
Strength of individual sunlight beams in water. Gaps remain clear; requires solar shadows.
broje.options.underwater_shaft_quality.t: 12 saves GPU time; 24 is balanced; 32/48 reduce grain and refine beam edges. Independent of reflection quality.
broje.options.underwater_reflections.too: Separately enables seabed reflection on the underside of water. Turning it off keeps the shore and sky visible.
broje.options.underwater_reflection_stre: Default: 20%. Even at 100% the surface remains transmissive, without forced total internal reflection.
broje.options.water_ssr_rays.tooltip: 1, 3 or 5 colour samples after a single trace. More samples soften fine shimmer at a small GPU cost.
broje.options.water_ssr_distance.tooltip: A shorter distance limits tracing; distant shores fall back to the sky.
broje.options.water_ssr_precise.tooltip: Extra depth samples refine receiver normals near block edges. Disable for higher FPS.
broje.options.underwater_reflection_reso: 128/256 save GPU time; 512/1024 preserve more seabed detail. Independent of screen resolution.
broje.options.underwater_reflection_dist: A smaller radius reduces terrain redraws. Reflections fade smoothly at its boundary.
broje.options.underwater_reflection_inte: Every 2/4/8 frames saves work. Between updates reflections stay anchored to the world as the view rotates.
broje.options.clouds.tooltip: Replaces Minecraft's flat clouds with volumetric ones: ray marching through a cloud layer lit by the sun and sky, with multiple scattering and a silver lining against the sun. Overworld only.
broje.options.cloud_style.tooltip: Minecraft: volumetric block clouds on a 12×12 grid like vanilla. Cumulus: dense cumulus fields. Realistic: single big and small clouds with clear sky between; big ones tower into the upper deck and sink below the main one.
broje.options.cloud_shadows.tooltip: Clouds block the sun and their shadows drift over the land. Needs sun shadows or lighting (GI) on.
broje.options.cloud_coverage.tooltip: How much of the sky is covered. Rain raises coverage and density by itself.
broje.options.cloud_height.tooltip: Nominal base of the main cloud layer. The lower banks sit beneath it; tall clouds can connect all three decks.
broje.options.cloud_thickness.tooltip: From the base to the highest tops. Thicker layers grow taller cumulus towers.
broje.options.cloud_density.tooltip: Lower is light and translucent, higher is heavy with dark undersides.
broje.options.cloud_fluffiness.tooltip: How loose the cloud edges are: 0% smooth domes, 80% rounded billows and wispy bases, 100% very airy.
broje.options.cloud_spread.tooltip: How far single clouds sit above or below each other. 0 puts every base at one height, like vanilla clouds.
broje.options.cloud_lower.tooltip: Low volumetric banks beneath the main layer. They can merge into the same cloud mass. 0% disables them in clear weather.
broje.options.cloud_upper.tooltip: Cloud banks above the main layer. They can merge with tall cumulus and shade the clouds below. 0% disables them in clear weather.
broje.options.cloud_evolution.tooltip: How fast clouds form out of clear air, grow, merge and dissolve. At 50% a cloud changes in about four minutes; 0% only drifts with the wind.
broje.options.cloud_wind.tooltip: Cloud drift speed: 100% is about 8 blocks per second. Fine detail travels with the clouds.
broje.options.cloud_distance.tooltip: How far clouds are computed. They dissolve smoothly into the sky near the limit.
broje.options.cloud_resolution.tooltip: 25% fast, 50% balanced: both cap the march at 960×540 to keep 4K affordable. 100% is uncapped full resolution. Silhouettes are reconstructed using depth.
broje.options.cloud_quality.tooltip: Sampling quality: 16/24 faster, 48/64 smoother shapes with less grain, especially while flying close to clouds.
